faq.q: What is the Feria San Bernabe 2048?
faq.a: Feria San Bernabe is Marbella's biggest annual fair, held in late June. In 2048, it runs from 23 to 29 June, with daytime family fun, evening concerts, and a lively fairground. The fair takes place at the Recinto Ferial, about 10 minutes from Puerto Banús, making it easy to combine fair visits with a boat party.

faq.q: Can I charter a boat for a Feria boat party in Marbella?

faq.a: Booking is easy. Send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, time, and group size. We'll confirm availability and send you a booking link. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, you can book directly online for €749/2h or €2,299/8h. For other boats, we'll provide a quote.

faq.q: Can we combine the boat party with the Feria fairground?

faq.q: What is the weather like in Marbella during Feria?
faq.a: Late June in Marbella is hot and sunny, with average highs of 28-30°C and sea temperatures around 22°C. Perfect for swimming and sunbathing. We recommend bringing sunscreen, a hat, and swimwear. The boat has shaded areas, and we provide water and soft drinks to keep you hydrated.

data.body_html:
Marbella's Feria San Bernabe is the highlight of the summer calendar, and in 2048 it promises to be bigger than ever. If you're looking for a unique way to celebrate, a Feria San Bernabe 2048 boat party in Marbella is the answer. Charter a private boat from Puerto Banús, sip cava as you cruise the Costa del Sol, and make the most of the long sunny days. With prices starting at €749 for 2 hours on the Astondoa 40, you can enjoy a luxury experience without the crowds.

Why Choose a Boat Party for Feria San Bernabe?

The Feria is a week-long celebration with flamenco, fairground rides, and late-night parties. But the real magic happens on the water. A boat party lets you escape the heat, enjoy panoramic views of La Concha mountain, and swim in the crystal-clear Mediterranean. You'll have your own skipper, so no one has to worry about driving. Plus, you can anchor near Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a refreshing dip.

Our Fleet for Feria Boat Parties

We have 17 boats available for charter, all departing from Puerto Banús. Here are the most popular choices for a Feria celebration:

  • Astondoa 40 – 12.5m, 9 guests, from €749/2h or €2,299/8h
  • Azimut 39 – 12.5m, 11 guests, from €749/2h or €2,299/8h
  • Mangusta 80 – 24m, 12 guests, €4,719 for 4h (jet ski included)
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge – 17.6m, 12 guests, price on request
  • Ferretti 94 – 29m, 12 guests, price on request

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 guests) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 guests) are perfect. All boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

Feria Week Itinerary Ideas

Make the most of your Feria boat party with a tailored itinerary. Here are three popular options:

  • 2-hour sunset cruise – Depart Puerto Banús at 19:00, cruise past the Golden Mile, and watch the sunset over the Mediterranean. Perfect for a pre-fair drink.
  • 4-hour beach hop – Head to Cabopino or Cala del Faro, anchor for a swim, and enjoy a light lunch on board. Return in time for the evening fair.
  • 8-hour full-day charter – Cruise to Estepona or Sotogrande, enjoy a long lunch, swim in secluded coves, and return as the sun sets. Ideal for a big group celebration.

What's Included in Your Charter?

Every boat rental includes the following, with no hidden extras:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You can also add extras like a jet ski (on the Mangusta 80 it's free), water toys, or a custom catering menu. Just ask via WhatsApp when booking.

How to Book Your Feria Boat Party

Booking is straightforward. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, you can reserve directly online for €749/2h or €2,299/8h. For all other boats, send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, time, and group size, and we'll confirm availability and pricing. We recommend booking early, as Feria week is one of the busiest times in Marbella.

Explore our full range of boats on our Marbella boat rental hub to find the perfect fit for your party.

Feria San Bernabe 2048 Dates & Local Tips

The Feria San Bernabe 2048 is scheduled for late June (exact dates to be confirmed). The fairground is located at Recinto Ferial, about 10 minutes from Puerto Banús. While the fair is free to enter, we recommend booking your boat party early to secure your preferred slot. After a day on the water, head to the fair for traditional dancing, churros, and live music.
